book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Pablo nagkamchaku carta agaja corintonmaya aidau awetimu

content: Dekanae atum ainajum anuiya tsanijinainamu, nunak Apajuí anentaimtuchu aidaukesh nuninatsui; nuniamunum makichik apají nuween nuwejai betek ema pujuju tabau antuewai.
Nuniaig atumek ememá batsatjume, nunitsuk wake besemag batsatkujum, nunú aents nuninun takaa puja duka jiikjum awemamainaitjume.
Wi atumjai ijunja pujachkunush wakannumag ijutkajai, nunin asan wi anui pujusan aents nunikun tumainaitag nuna tajai:
Apu Jesucristo daajin, niina senchijin ijuntatjum nuanuig, wishakam mina wakanjuig atumjai ijutkau atatag dui;
nunú aentsuk Satanás idaitustajum, dutikam ni nuna iyashin suwimak susam waitiak, pujutjin yapajia Apu Jesús minitaish wakanin uwemjati.
Atumek ememasjum anentaimainchau ainagme, dekagme: “Pag najanatasa nanegbauwa nunak levadura piipich ajuntuamuitak ashí utujá wampushmitkauwai” tawa duka.
Levadura yaunchuk ajutjamajakajua duka utsagtajum, nunikjum yamajam nanegbau wajastajum, levaduragtuchu ainajum nunisjumek, wagki iina pascuaji Cristua duka jutiiní mantamdau asamtai.
Nunin asamtai yaunchuk tudau takainaku pegkegchau unuimatkamu aina nunisaik pujusaik Cristo ememattsuk, yamajam pujut dekas pegkeg aina nu takainaku dekaskenum emematiagmi.
Wi duik papiin agajan awetibiajim duishkam tsanijimtan idaiyinatsu nujaig ijunjaigpajum tibaijime.

Wika junak anui aents Cristun nemagchau aidau tsanijimtan batsamtin, ekagbau, suji, tsanumag kasamin, apajuimtai dakumkamun emematin batsataina nujai tupandaikatajum tusanuk tichabiajime. Nu nunikta takugmek ju nugka ju ukuakjum nunimainaitjume.

Wika nunak, Jesucristo nemajin asá yatsut ainaji tayatak tsanijimtanak wekaetin, suji, apajimtai dakumkamun emematin, pegkegchaun chichagkagtin, nampen, tsanumag kasamin aina nujaig ijunmaitsugme tibaijime. Aents nunin aidaujaig makichkish ijunjagmek yuwawaigpajum.
Wika Apajuí nemajuinatsu nunak suwimak susatajum tumaitsujime. Untsu Jesús nemagjum nuiya pegkegchau takainakuig, atumek pempeentunisjumek wajuk juwaktatua duka tumain ainagme.
Apajuí nemajuinatsu nunak, Apajuí titatui; nunin asamtai atumiin pegkegchau takau puja duka jiikí ajapatajum.
